method: Challenge queues are deterministic review-workflow queues generated from evidence capsules. Queue order is for review operations only and is not a ranking, severity score, safety score, prevalence estimate, legal finding, endorsement, or external audit.

queues.label: Single-source high-priority review
queues.description: Single-source records where additional public support or narrower language would improve reviewability.

queues.label: Broad-label challenges
queues.description: Records with broad category or affected-community labels that deserve label-boundary review.

queues.label: Institutional-response challenges
queues.description: Records where public response text or response-depth classification should be checked against public sources.

queues.label: Confidence-rationale challenges
queues.description: Records where confidence labels need explicit source-support rationale.

queues.label: Dataset locator challenges
queues.description: Dataset-derived records where workbook, row, or cell-level provenance should be made clearer.

queues.label: Legal-status challenges
queues.description: Records with legal, OCR, procedural, or investigative language that should be checked for precision.

queues.label: Gold record candidates
queues.description: Records worth upgrading into fully argued examples with alternate interpretations and change criteria.
